probe_detail.name: Argues the step a competent reader would stop at
Use of AoPS forum markup furniture
Delivers the object the problem asked for

final.name: Validation-seeking and uncertain posture
final.audit_justification: Measures hedging/validation-seeking register, a tone marker independent of which mathematical method is used.

final.name: Algebraic step transparency
final.audit_justification: Measures how much intermediate algebra is written out, a verbosity/completeness trait rather than which method is used, though a meticulous writer may also be more likely to reason correctly.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores how much intermediate algebra is written out, which is a completeness/verbosity property of the write-up rather than which method the solver used; the same approach can be shown in one line or ten. Its upstream cause (a meticulous, careful writer) plausibly also produces more canonical and correct reasoning, so it is reported both ways.

final.name: Explicit claim-proof structuring
final.audit_justification: Scores the use of generic 'Claim:'/'Lemma:' organizational labels, a template/formatting habit rather than the underlying mathematical content.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction keys on the presence of organizational markers ('Claim:', 'Lemma:') and proof blocks, a presentation template that any approach -- canonical or divergent -- can be dressed in. A judge scoring exactly this text would measure formatting convention, not approach identity, so it is a declared nuisance.

final.name: Strategic use of symmetry
final.audit_justification: Directly assesses whether a specific mathematical technique (symmetry/invariance) is genuinely and correctly load-bearing in the argument, i.e. the substance of the method used.

final.name: Legacy autocorrupted LaTeX and era-marked forum markup
final.audit_justification: Purely counts typographic/markup artifacts tied to an older forum software era, unrelated to the mathematical content or method.
final.upstream_parent: the calendar era in which the post was written (and later software migrations that rewrote old posts)

final.name: Absence of unconventional-approach markers
final.audit_justification: Scores the presence/absence of self-deprecating labels like 'troll' or 'overkill' describing the approach, a linguistic self-report rather than the approach itself, though a poster's own sense that their approach is unusual may sometimes track a genuinely divergent method.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction is a lexical detector for AoPS community slang ('troll', 'scuffed', 'overkill'), so it scores register and self-presentation rather than the method on the page; a canonical solution by a slang-using poster is penalized and a divergent one by a plain writer is not. The self-label is nonetheless sometimes caused by a genuinely non-standard approach, so it is flagged mixed.

final.name: Contest-conditions self-report and score talk
final.audit_justification: Captures narration of the circumstances of the post's production (contest timing, scores), a fingerprint of upstream production context rather than the solution's method.
final.upstream_parent: timing of production/submission relative to the competition (a same-week contestant post versus a later archival write-up)

final.name: Colloquial and emotional register
final.audit_justification: Measures informal/emotional register versus formal prose, a stylistic register marker unrelated to which method is used.
final.upstream_parent: poster's practice in the format / audience expectation

final.name: Global closure of local alternatives
final.audit_justification: Assesses a specific substantive step (whether local possibilities are shown to combine into one consistent global solution), which is direct content of the mathematical argument.

final.name: Answer-choice anchoring
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores only the surface 'assessment-format trace' of foregrounding answer choices, not whether that structure was load-bearing, though the same multiple-choice context could genuinely alter the approach taken.

final.name: Single external theorem does all the work
final.audit_justification: Assesses how much of the argument is problem-specific work versus outsourced to an unproved external citation, which is direct evidence about the substance of the method used.

final.name: Exploits the multiple-choice option list
final.audit_justification: Directly measures whether the solving method exploits the option list as a load-bearing part of the derivation, which is a substantive fact about the approach taken.

final.name: Completeness of candidate classification
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether candidates are both fully derived and verified, a substantive property of the argument's completeness and method.

final.name: Explicit self-assessment labels
final.audit_justification: Counts self-applied qualitative labels like 'cheap' or 'scuffed', a self-report phrasing habit rather than the approach itself, though such labels sometimes genuinely flag a non-standard method.

final.name: Inter-post referencing and sequence markers
final.audit_justification: Counts references to other posts or thread position, a social/sequence fingerprint of the item's place in the forum rather than its mathematical content.

final.name: Isolable pivotal-fact statement
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a specific pivotal identity or lemma is isolated as the crux, which is substantive evidence about the structure of the method used.

final.name: Names and separately addresses a trap or edge case
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a specific named edge case is separately and explicitly resolved, a substantive property of the argument's content and rigor.

final.name: Collaboration attribution
final.audit_justification: Counts explicit references to collaborators or thanks, a fingerprint of the item's production circumstances, though genuine collaborative help could also push a solution toward a more correct or standard method.

final.name: Exact modular periodicity
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a period or residue restriction is actually proved and exhaustively applied, direct substantive content of the argument.

final.name: Method sophistication proportionality to problem
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether the sophistication of the tools used is proportionate to the problem, a substantive judgment about which method was chosen relative to what the problem calls for.

final.name: Density of display mathematics and align environments
final.audit_justification: Measures the proportion of mathematics set as display/aligned blocks versus inline, a pure typesetting trait explicitly decoupled from correctness or method.
final.upstream_parent: the poster's practice and fluency with the forum's typesetting conventions

final.name: Post questions or disowns the argument it posts
final.audit_justification: Scores the poster's stance of ownership toward the argument (asserted, hedged, or disowned), primarily a register/framing trait, though a disowned or reproduced argument may genuinely not represent the poster's own solution approach.
final.arbiter_reason: Scoring whether the post asserts, hedges, or disowns its argument requires reading the epistemic status of the displayed reasoning, and a post that asks why its answer is wrong or reproduces another's argument to object to it is thereby evidence that the displayed derivation is not an endorsed solution matching the reference. This is evidence about whether the item takes the canonical approach at all, not a mere framing tell.

final.name: Objective-preserving optimization
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether the optimization target is rigorously reduced while preserving the optimization direction, substantive mathematical content of the method.

final.name: Markup scaffolding
final.audit_justification: Scores visual organizational scaffolding (hides, headings, bullets, boxes) explicitly without judging whether it helps, a pure formatting trait.

final.name: Generalizes beyond the minimum needed
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the post goes beyond the minimum required scope, a thoroughness/effort trait rather than evidence about which approach was taken, though stronger solvers who generalize may also be more likely to use the canonical rigorous method.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores extra scope -- generalizations, bonus observations, 'further remarks' sections -- which is a thoroughness/effort trait orthogonal to which route the solution took to the requested answer. Solvers who generalize may also be more likely to use the standard rigorous method, so it is reported in both discounted and undiscounted readouts.
